DeathwingDragonSoul.name: Dragon Soul
DeathwingDragonSoul.description: Destroyer: Incinerate heals Deathwing for 100% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. World Breaker: Lava Burst's explosion damage heals Deathwing for 200% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.

DeathwingMoltenBlood.name: Molten Blood
DeathwingMoltenBlood.description: While Deathwing has 3 or more Armor Plates, he heals for 0.6% of his maximum Health per second.

DeathwingDraconicMight.name: Draconic Might
DeathwingDraconicMight.description: Deathwing's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal him for 25% of the damage dealt. Upon losing an Armor Plate, Deathwing becomes Protected for 0.75 seconds.

DeathwingInfernus.name: Infernus
DeathwingInfernus.description: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by 25%. Increase this damage bonus to 75% when Molten Flame is cast at 75 Energy or higher.

DeathwingHeatWave.name: Heat Wave
DeathwingHeatWave.description: Destroyer: After hitting an enemy Hero with Incinerate, Deathwing deals 18 damage per second to all nearby enemies for the next 9 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times. World Breaker: Increase the explosion damage of Lava Burst by 150%.

DeathwingDragonsIre.name: Dragon's Ire
DeathwingDragonsIre.description: While Deathwing has 3 or fewer Armor Plates, his damage is increased by 25%.

DeathwingFirestorm.name: Firestorm
DeathwingFirestorm.description: Reduce the cooldown of Deathwing's landing Abilities by 3 seconds. When Deathwing lands, he drops 7 meteors near the landing area, dealing 77 damage to enemies hit. Meteors prioritize landing on Heroes, otherwise they fall randomly in the area.

DeathwingDeathDrop.name: Death Drop
DeathwingDeathDrop.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and Deathwing's Basic Ability cooldowns by 2 seconds.

DeathwingSkyfall.name: Skyfall
DeathwingSkyfall.description: After using Dragonflight, Deathwing can drop meteors anywhere within vision dealing 58 damage to enemies in the area. Has 3 charges. If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.name: Burn Beneath My Shadow
DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.description: When an enemy Fort or Keep is destroyed the cooldown of Cataclysm is reset. Cataclysm's periodic damage is increased by 80%.

DeathwingBellowingRoar.name: Bellowing Roar
DeathwingBellowingRoar.description: After 1 second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing 25 damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for 1.5 seconds.

DeathwingWickedInferno.name: Wicked Inferno
DeathwingWickedInferno.description: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by 10. After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains 15 Energy over 3 seconds.

DeathwingRuination.name: Ruination
DeathwingRuination.description: Destroyer: The bite from Onslaught now Slows by 60% for 1.5 seconds. World Breaker: Reduce Earth Shatter's cooldown by 6 seconds and its Energy cost by 10.

DeathwingFireAndFury.name: Fire and Fury
DeathwingFireAndFury.description: Basic Attacks against Rooted, Slowed, or Stunned enemy Heroes deal 40% additional damage and reduce the cooldowns of Deathwing's Basic Abilities by 0.5 seconds.

DeathwingConflagration.name: Conflagration
DeathwingConflagration.description: Dealing 320 damage with Molten Flame to enemy Heroes within 4 seconds causes them to burn for an additional 100 damage over 4 seconds. While burning, they explode every 1 second, dealing 80 damage to all nearby enemies.

DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.name: Gaze Onto Destruction
DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.description: Hitting Heroes with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing causes their damage to be reduced by 75% and Slows them by 40% for 3.5 Seconds.

DeathwingElementiumPlating.name: Elementium Plating
DeathwingElementiumPlating.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 30% of Deathwing's missing Health for 8 seconds. While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates 2% of his maximum Health per second. When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health. The Shiel

DeathwingStoodInTheFire.name: Stood in the Fire
DeathwingStoodInTheFire.description: Enemy Heroes are Slowed by 40% while standing in scorched ground, and its duration is increased by 50%.

DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.name: Arrival of a God
DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.description: Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage is increased by 400%. Deathwing also gains the benefits of all of his level 7 talents.

DeathwingDestroyersRampage.name: Destroyer's Rampage
DeathwingDestroyersRampage.description: For the next 4 seconds after landing in Destroyer form, Deathwing's damage is increased by 40% and his Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster. Damaging Heroes refreshes this effect.
